seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result

args.content: Bug: unique_preserve_order returned list(set(items)), which discards the original ordering because sets are unordered, so the result came back in arbitrary order and the ordering tests failed. Fix: iterate the input once, track already-seen items in a set, and append each item the first time it appears. This preserves first-seen order, runs in O(n), handles empty input, and passes all three tests in the suite without modifying any test files.
